description: This file defines a Set interface and its implementations (unsafeSet and tsafeSet) for managing collections of strings, including thread-safe operations, within the etcd project.

classes.name: unsafeSet
classes.description: A non-thread-safe implementation of a set of strings.

classes.name: tsafeSet
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around unsafeSet for concurrent access.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a value to the set.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the set.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the set.

methods.name: ContainsAll
methods.description: Checks if all specified values are in the set.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two sets have identical contents.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.

methods.name: Values
methods.description: Returns all values in the set.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the set.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Returns a subset excluding elements found in another set.
